summary: ENGINE DISGUISE SYSTEM (openmohaa-hzm/code/fgame, as built 2026-08-09). Three cooperating layers: (1) Player::Think recomputes player.m_bIsDisguised every frame (player.cpp:5479-5518, now gated by g_coopDisgParity default 1 instead of SP-only): holstered-or-InventoryItem = disguised, any real weapon drawn = blown, level.m_bAlarm or !m_bHasDisguise = never disguised, with a veto scan over team-0 sentients requiring m_Enemy==player && IsAttacking() && GetCurrentThreat()>0 (bug-1631 fix). (2) Per-actor belief and gate: EnemyIsDisguised() (actor.h:2159) = (m_bEnemyIsDisguised OR m_Enemy->m_bIsDisguised) AND !m_bForceAttackPlayer AND m_ThinkState!=THINKSTATE_ATTACK; m_bForceAttackPlayer is a one-way latch set only by ForceAttackPlayer (script attackplayer, actor.cpp:9336) and cleared only in the constructor (actor.cpp:3092). Disguised players produce FULL visibility but ZERO threat (actorenemy.cpp:164), and CheckEnemies retains a disguised current-enemy at zero threat (actorenemy.cpp:469) - that retention is what keeps a papers-checker locked on. (3) THINKSTATE_DISGUISE (=6) with five thinks selected by 'type_disguise salute|sentry|officer|rover|none' (default salute): sentry runs the real WAIT->PAPERS->ACCEPT/DENY flow (accept executes disguise_accept_thread with self=actor, then permanently demotes the actor to salute-type; deny returns to IDLE, not attack), officer/rover run State_Disguise_Fake_Papers with NO accept path (papers shown OR 12s -> ENEMY; >256u away -> HALT; both end in SetThinkState(ATTACK)), salute just salutes until anim end. Entry is gated by PassesTransitionConditions_Disguise (actor.cpp:9000): confirmed enemy (visibility>=0.999), EnemyIsDisguised, |dz|<=48, 32<dist2D<disguise_range (default 256), 200ms scan throttle, per-actor m_iNextDisguiseTime cooldown (500ms after WAIT-only, disguise_period=30s after a real exchange), and a sight trace HARD-CODED to G_GetEntity(0)->centroid. Papers are shown via the papers InventoryItem fire anim firing 'activatepapers' (inventoryitem.cpp:81-84) which stamps owner m_ShowPapersTime; states compare it against a snapshot taken at state Begin. level.m_bAlarm and level.m_iPapersLevel are pure script properties (level.alarm / level.papers, level.cpp:2062-2100) - the engine NEVER sets them; alarm=1 kills all disguise behavior level-wide (player maintenance refuses the flag; every disguise Begin/Think bails to ATTACK). THINK_ALARM (actor_alarm.cpp) is an attack-type think: run to alarmnode, execute prealarmthread+alarmthread (which script-side raises level.alarm), then convert to THINK_TURRET. The bug-1631 freeze is fully explained: GlobalFuncs is a zero-initialized static array and InitDisguiseNone sets ONLY IsState, so 'type_disguise none' fired while the actor is inside THINKSTATE_DISGUISE goes through SetThink dirty-flag -> ThinkStateTransitions same-level EndState+BeginState -> NULL BeginState/ThinkState -> actor frozen mid-anim forever, because the transition scan (CheckForThinkStateTransition) only runs from inside idle-family think functions that never execute again.
key_facts: PLAYER MAINTENANCE (player.cpp:5479-5518, in Player::Think): runs when g_gametype==GT_SINGLE_PLAYER OR g_coopDisgParity (lazy gi.Cvar_Get, default "1", flags 0 - live-revertable). Order: m_bIsDisguised=false; then only if (m_bHasDisguise && !level.m_bAlarm): pWeap=GetActiveWeapon(WEAPON_MAIN); if (!pWeap || pWeap->IsSubclassOfInventoryItem()) m_bIsDisguised=true, then veto scan over level.m_HeadSentient[0] (team-0/axis sentient list cast to Actor*): any with pSent->m_Enemy==this && act->IsAttacking() && act->m_PotentialEnemies.GetCurrentThreat()>0 flips it back false (the >0 threat clause is the bug-1631 fix; vanilla had no threat check). PathSearch::PlayerCover and UpdateEnemies remain SP-only (5522-5525).

SENTIENT FIELDS (sentient.h:206-208, init sentient.cpp:869-871): m_bIsDisguised, m_bHasDisguise, m_ShowPapersTime - all init false/0, all archived. Script surface (player.cpp events 1149-1178, handlers 11376/11381/11386): is_disguised = EV_GETTER ONLY (engine-computed, scripts cannot set it); has_disguise = getter + setter (GetBoolean). m_ShowPapersTime is written in exactly ONE place: InventoryItem::ActivatePapers (inventoryitem.cpp:81-84) 'GetOwner()->m_ShowPapersTime = level.inttime', bound to event 'activatepapers' (EV_InventoryItem_Activate_Papers, inventoryitem.cpp:38-50), fired by TIKI server frame commands in the papers item fire anim (papers.tik/papers2.tik show_papers.skc, frames 30/40/50/60/70 per docs/proposals/research_m2l2a/02_engine.md).

EnemyIsDisguised (actor.h:2159-2174, inline): return false if (!m_bEnemyIsDisguised && !m_Enemy->m_bIsDisguised); return false if m_bForceAttackPlayer; return false if m_ThinkState==THINKSTATE_ATTACK; else true. NOTE: dereferences m_Enemy unguarded - every caller must ensure m_Enemy != NULL first. The third clause means an actor already in attack thinkstate considers NO enemy disguised (and via the player veto scan, keeps the player's flag suppressed only when threat>0 post-fix).

m_bForceAttackPlayer writes: ctor false (actor.cpp:3092); ForceAttackPlayer() true (actor.cpp:9336-9340) - which ALSO does m_PotentialEnemies.ConfirmEnemy(this, G_GetEntity(0)) i.e. hard-coded player slot 0. Reached from script 'attackplayer' (EventAttackPlayer 9347). It is never cleared anywhere else: per-actor permanent disguise blindness. HZM's EventAttackEntity (9365+) confirms arbitrary sentients but does NOT set the latch.

m_bEnemyIsDisguised (actor-side belief) writes: ctor false (2984); SetEnemy on enemy CHANGE (actor.cpp:6889-6915, line 6906): = m_Enemy->m_bHasDisguise && (m_Enemy->m_bIsDisguised || !CanSeeEnemy(0)) - an unseen player who merely OWNS a disguise is presumed disguised; Actor::CanSee success on current enemy (4031-4035): refreshed from live m_Enemy->m_bIsDisguised every successful sight check; ActorEnemySet::ConfirmEnemy (actorenemy.cpp:501) and ConfirmEnemyIfCanSeeSharerOrEnemy (528): forced false; Actor::NoticeShot (actor.cpp:10035-10051): when a SAME-TEAM shooter fires, belief forced false (axis gunfire tells everyone the disguise is off). Belief only matters when the live player flag is false or player unseen, since EnemyIsDisguised ORs them.

THREAT PIPELINE (actorenemy.cpp): ActorEnemy::UpdateThreat (128-166): threat=0 if m_pEnemy->m_bIsDisguised || totalVisibility<0.999 || below per-enemy reaction time (m_iNextEnemyTime); otherwise 10000/10500 base + weapon/range table. So disguised players accumulate FULL visibility (UpdateVisibility 102-126 has no disguise gate) but ZERO threat. ActorEnemySet::CheckEnemies (341-474): eviction loop drops entries that are dead/same-team/aged >10s since m_iAddTime/THREATBIAS_IGNOREME/IsDisabled (AddPotentialEnemy refreshes m_iAddTime on re-add, 287); visibility-based selection sets m_pCurrentEnemy even at zero threat (403-409); final retention clause 469: a disguised m_pCurrentEnemy is RETAINED at threat<=0, a non-disguised one is dropped. IsEnemyConfirmed = m_fCurrentVisibility>0.999 (actorenemy.h:141-144).

THINKSTATE MACHINERY: eThinkState VOID=0 IDLE=1 PAIN=2 KILLED=3 ATTACK=4 CURIOUS=5 DISGUISE=6 BADPLACE=7 GRENADE=8 NOCLIP=9 (actor.h:337-349). eThinkNum: THINK_DISGUISE_SALUTE=10, SENTRY=11, OFFICER=12, ROVER=13, NONE=14, THINK_ALARM=15 (actor.h:351-390). Script strings for type_disguise: 'salute','sentry','officer','rover','none' (scriptmaster.cpp:347-351). Default m_ThinkMap[THINKSTATE_DISGUISE]=THINK_DISGUISE_SALUTE (InitThinkStates actor.cpp:8485; BecomeTurretGuy re-forces it 13103). EventSetTypeDisguise (8272-8286) validates via GlobalFuncs[think].IsState(THINKSTATE_DISGUISE) - all five disguise thinks pass (InitDisguiseNone sets IsState=IsDisguiseState); invalid names reset to SALUTE + ScriptError.

SETTHINK SEMANTICS (actor.cpp:7925-7954): SetThink writes m_ThinkMap[state]; if the actor is currently IN that thinkstate it sets m_bDirtyThinkState. Per-frame in Actor::Think (7774-7783): dirty -> ThinkStateTransitions(); then GlobalFuncs[m_Think[m_ThinkLevel]].ThinkState is called ONLY if non-NULL. ThinkStateTransitions (8637-8685) same-level changed-think path: EndState(level) then BeginState() of the NEW think (BeginState wrapper 8547-8559 also updates m_Think[level]=m_ThinkMap[state]). GlobalFuncs is 'static GlobalFuncs_t GlobalFuncs[NUM_THINKS]' (actor.h:596-624) = zero-initialized; InitDisguiseNone (actor_disguise_common.cpp:65-68) sets ONLY IsState, so THINK_DISGUISE_NONE has NULL ThinkState/Begin/End/Suspend/Resume/PassesTransitionConditions.

FREEZE MECHANISM (bug-1631, now instrumented): 'type_disguise none' while m_ThinkState==THINKSTATE_DISGUISE -> SetThink dirty -> same-level End_Disguise* (arms m_iNextDisguiseTime) + NULL BeginState -> next frames dispatch NULL ThinkState -> actor does NOTHING forever, pinned in THINKSTATE_DISGUISE mid-anim. Nothing rescues it because CheckForThinkStateTransition() is invoked ONLY from inside idle-family ThinkState functions (actor_idle.cpp:101, actor_patrol.cpp:73, actor_curious.cpp x6, actor_runner.cpp:68, actor_anim.cpp:66, actor_animcurious.cpp:60, actor_aim.cpp:58, actor_dog.cpp x4, actor_runandshoot.cpp:85) - which never run again. HZM tracers (g_coopDisgDebug 1): CoopDisgTrace/Tick in actor_disguise_common.cpp:27-63, SETTHINK trace with DumpCallTrace at actor.cpp:7927-7947, SETSTATE trace at 8026-8047, player-entry EVICT trace in actorenemy.cpp:358-380.

TYPE_DISGUISE NONE WHILE IDLE (the safe case): CheckForTransition (actor.cpp:8905-8924) returns false when func->PassesTransitionConditions is NULL, so a none-think actor simply never enters the disguise state; with a disguised player, PassesTransitionConditions_Attack (8974-8990) ALSO fails (requires !EnemyIsDisguised() && IsEnemyConfirmed) and PassesTransitionConditions_Curious (9061-9085) requires !EnemyIsDisguised() on its enemy clause - so the actor stays idle: disguise still protects, the actor just never challenges. Transition priority in CheckForThinkStateTransition (8873-8896): GRENADE, BADPLACE, then (if m_bEnableEnemy) ATTACK before DISGUISE, then CURIOUS, then IDLE.

DISGUISE-STATE ENTRY GATES, PassesTransitionConditions_Disguise (actor.cpp:9000-9052), evaluated in order: !m_bLockThinkState; m_iNextDisguiseTime<=now else false, then re-arm now+200 (scan throttle); UpdateEnemy(200) and m_Enemy!=NULL; EnemyIsDisguised(); m_PotentialEnemies.IsEnemyConfirmed() (vis>=0.999); fabs(dz)<=48 (same floor); 32^2 < dist2D^2 < m_fMaxDisguiseDistSquared; final G_SightTrace from actor EyePosition() to G_GetEntity(0)->centroid with MASK_TRANSITION - HARD-CODED ENTITY 0, not m_Enemy. Tunables: disguise_range (EventSetDisguiseRange 9259, stores Square(value), default Square(256), ctor 3026), disguise_period (EventSetDisguisePeriod 9280, script value in SECONDS stored *1000+0.5, default 30000 ms, ctor 3025), m_iNextDisguiseTime ctor=1 (3024).

SENTRY THINK (actor_disguise_sentry.cpp, the only full papers flow): Begin: assert/bail-IDLE on !m_Enemy; if ((EnemyIsDisguised()||FL_NOTARGET) && level.m_bAlarm!=qtrue) snapshot m_iEnemyShowPapersTime=m_Enemy->m_ShowPapersTime, face enemy, TransitionState(WAIT); else SetThinkState(ATTACK). Think: RequireThink; UpdateEnemy(1500); !m_Enemy->IDLE; if (!EnemyIsDisguised() && !FL_NOTARGET && m_State!=ENEMY) TransitionState(ENEMY,0); if (level.m_bAlarm) SetThinkState(ATTACK) return; face enemy; dispatch. States (actor_disguise_common.cpp): WAIT (70-94): if dist2D^2*4 < maxDisguiseDist^2 -> PAPERS; after 3000ms: dist>256 -> IDLE thinkstate else PAPERS. PAPERS (96-121): while enemy has NOT shown papers since snapshot (m_iEnemyShowPapersTime >= m_Enemy->m_ShowPapersTime): 12000ms timeout -> ENEMY, walked >256 -> HALT(0); when papers SHOWN: level.m_iPapersLevel < m_iDisguiseLevel -> DENY, else execute m_DisguiseAcceptThread (if set, self=the actor) then -> ACCEPT. ACCEPT (159-167): anim 3000ms -> THINKSTATE_IDLE + SetThink(DISGUISE, THINK_DISGUISE_SALUTE) - a sentry accepts ONCE then is a saluter for life. DENY (169-176): anim 3000ms -> THINKSTATE_IDLE (NOT attack). ENEMY (141-148): anim, after 3000ms if !FL_NOTARGET -> THINKSTATE_ATTACK. HALT (150-157): anim, after 1500ms if !FL_NOTARGET -> THINKSTATE_ATTACK.

OFFICER/ROVER THINKS (actor_disguise_officer.cpp / _rover.cpp): Begin identical to sentry but enters PAPERS directly (papers anim, snapshot). Their PAPERS dispatch calls State_Disguise_Fake_Papers (common.cpp:123-139): if (papers shown since snapshot OR 12000ms in state) -> ENEMY; dist>256 -> HALT(0). There is NO accept and NO deny path: every completed officer/rover encounter ends hostile (show papers -> ENEMY; wait 12s -> ENEMY; walk away -> HALT -> 1.5s -> ATTACK). Rover's dispatch includes an ACCEPT case defensively but nothing transitions to it. Officer/rover End/Suspend identical to sentry. Rover has NO HZM tracer calls; officer/sentry/salute do.

SALUTE THINK (actor_disguise_salute.cpp): Begin: prints 'Saluting guy....' (vanilla Com_Printf), salute anim, NO TransitionState (m_State untouched). Think: NO RequireThink gate, no m_State dispatch, no grenade CheckForTransition; blown or alarm -> SetThinkState(ATTACK) immediately (no ENEMY-state 3s buffer); FinishedAnimation_DisguiseSalute -> THINKSTATE_IDLE. End/Suspend: m_iNextDisguiseTime = now + m_iDisguisePeriod UNCONDITIONALLY (full 30s).

COOLDOWN ASYMMETRY: End_DisguiseSentry/Officer/Rover: m_iNextDisguiseTime = level.inttime + (m_State ? m_iDisguisePeriod : 500). ACTOR_STATE_DISGUISE_WAIT==0 (enum actor.h:432-440: WAIT=0, PAPERS=1, ACCEPT=2, ENEMY=3, HALT=4, DENY=5), so leaving from WAIT re-arms in 500ms but leaving from ANY later state (papers/accept/deny/enemy/halt) waits the full disguise_period (default 30s). Suspend_* delegates to End_*, Resume_* to Begin_* - so a higher-level interruption (pain/grenade) that suspends and resumes re-runs Begin (fresh snapshot, fresh state).

DISGUISE LEVELS: m_iDisguiseLevel per-actor (ctor 1, actor.cpp:3027), 'disguise_level' event (8327-8335) accepts only 1 or 2 (else resets to 1 and ScriptErrors - message prints the already-reset value). level.m_iPapersLevel: 'level.papers' property (level.cpp:163-179 events, 2092-2100 handlers), init 0 per map (769-770), archived. ENGINE NEVER RAISES IT - retail map scripts set level.papers when the player picks up better papers. Accept requires level.m_iPapersLevel >= m_iDisguiseLevel at the instant papers are shown. disguise_accept_thread ('disguise_accept_thread' events actor.cpp:1064-1082, handlers 8293-8310) is a ScriptThreadLabel executed on the ACTOR (self=actor) at accept time.

ALARM: level.m_bAlarm - 'level.alarm' property (level.cpp:2062-2070), init false (769), archived (2633). Engine-side grep confirms NO engine write besides the event handler: alarm is 100% script-raised (and script-clearable). Effects when true: player maintenance never grants m_bIsDisguised (player.cpp:5493); every disguise Begin_* bails to SetThinkState(ATTACK); every disguise Think_* bails to ATTACK on its next tick. THINK_ALARM (actor_alarm.cpp, 'type_attack alarm', attack-slot think using PassesTransitionConditions_Attack + IsAttackState): Begin_Alarm: DoForceActivate, mood alert; no m_AlarmNode -> State_Alarm_StartThread immediately; else SetPath(m_AlarmNode) and ALARM_MOVE (path fail -> ALARM_IDLE + parm.movefail). State_Alarm_StartThread (63-72): SetLeashHome(node origin or self), execute m_PreAlarmThread (2.30 'prealarmthread', 8132-8138), TransitionState(ALARM_IDLE), execute m_AlarmThread ('alarmthread', 8146-8152, executed with self=actor). State_Alarm_Move: PathComplete -> StartThread. State_Alarm_Idle (92-97): Anim_Aim + SetThink(THINKSTATE_ATTACK, THINK_TURRET) - converts to a normal turret-attacker after firing the threads. m_AlarmNode set by 'alarmnode' targetname lookup (8107-8114). Because THINK_ALARM sits in the ATTACK slot, it only begins once the actor actually enters attack thinkstate (disguise blown / enemy confirmed / disguise-state ENEMY-HALT exits).

WHAT DISGUISE BUYS THE PLAYER ELSEWHERE: NoticeFootstep (actor.cpp:10061-10064) ignores disguised pedestrians; G_BroadcastAIEvent (g_utils.cpp:1798-1804) drops AI_EVENT_MISC/MISC_LOUD entirely when G_GetEntity(0) is disguised (hard-coded player 0 again - the event ORIGINATOR is not checked); Sentient::IsTeamMate (sentient.cpp:4008-4019) counts a disguised sentient as a teammate (squad logic); machine-gunner manned-gun think requires !EnemyIsDisguised() to engage (actor_machinegunner.cpp:333-338); UpdateThreat zero-threat as above. Curious state is NOT triggered by a disguised confirmed enemy (9079 requires !EnemyIsDisguised).

STRING-CONSTANT REUSE WARNING: STRING_DISGUISE_NONE is literally the string 'none' and is reused by TurretGun::AI_EventSetTargetType (weapturret.cpp:2236-2256, targettype none/auto) and a scriptthread team compare (scriptthread.cpp:4363). Greps for the constant hit non-disguise code; only actor.cpp/actor_disguise_*.cpp uses are disguise-related. Similarly THINK_BALCONY_DISGUISE (actor.h:380) is a separate balcony-guy disguise think NOT audited here.

PLAYER VETO SCAN SUBTLETY: the maintenance iterates level.m_HeadSentient[0] and casts EVERY node to Actor* then calls IsAttacking()/m_PotentialEnemies - team list 0 is the axis side in retail SP data. m_HeadSentient is a Sentient list; non-Actor sentients on that team (another PLAYER forced to team axis) would be cast wrongly - in practice retail/coop keeps players on team 1 (allies) and only AI on team 0, but forcing a player to the axis team while parity is on would make the scan read garbage through the Actor cast.

ARCHIVES/SAVEGAME: m_bEnemyIsDisguised, m_bForceAttackPlayer, m_iNextDisguiseTime, m_iDisguisePeriod, m_fMaxDisguiseDistSquared, m_DisguiseAcceptThread, m_iDisguiseLevel all archived (actor.h:1946-1996); sentient trio archived (sentient.cpp:3338-3341); level alarm/papers archived (level.cpp:2633-2636). Irrelevant to coop (no savegames) but means SP saves round-trip the full machine.
mechanisms: Disguise grant/blow loop (per frame, per player): scripts set has_disguise 1 -> engine computes is_disguised from active weapon (none or InventoryItem = disguised) -> actors read it live through EnemyIsDisguised() -> drawing any weapon blows it the SAME frame, holstering restores it the next frame (no memory, except each actor's m_bEnemyIsDisguised belief refreshed on sight checks and enemy-set).

Challenge lifecycle: player visible to actor -> ActorEnemy visibility integrates to 1.0 (confirmed) while threat stays 0 (disguised) -> CheckEnemies retention keeps player as current enemy -> idle-family think's CheckForThinkStateTransition: ATTACK fails (EnemyIsDisguised), DISGUISE passes (range/floor/trace/cooldown) -> THINKSTATE_DISGUISE with the actor's type_disguise think -> papers exchange driven by m_ShowPapersTime vs Begin-time snapshot -> exit to IDLE (accept/deny/sentry-demotes-to-salute) or to ATTACK (blown/ENEMY/HALT/alarm), End arms the re-challenge cooldown.

Show-papers action path: player selects papers InventoryItem (toggleitem) -> primary fire plays show_papers anim -> TIKI server frame commands 'activatepapers' (frames 30/40/50/60/70) -> EV_InventoryItem_Activate_Papers -> InventoryItem::ActivatePapers -> owner->m_ShowPapersTime=level.inttime -> checker's PAPERS state sees snapshot < m_ShowPapersTime and resolves accept/deny (sentry) or instant-ENEMY (officer/rover). Holding the papers item also satisfies the maintenance's InventoryItem clause, so showing papers never blows the disguise.

Alarm cascade (all script-fed, engine-executed): disguise blown -> actor enters ATTACK thinkstate -> an actor with type_attack alarm runs Begin_Alarm -> paths to alarmnode -> executes prealarmthread+alarmthread (script raises level.alarm=1, spawns reinforcements) -> actor becomes THINK_TURRET attacker; level.m_bAlarm=1 then disables the player disguise flag and dumps every disguise-state actor to ATTACK on their next tick; script can set level.alarm=0 to restore stealth (guards do not re-holster their memory: m_bEnemyIsDisguised beliefs persist until next sight check of a re-disguised player).

Freeze failure mode (must-avoid): script swaps type_disguise while actor m_ThinkState==THINKSTATE_DISGUISE -> ThinkStateTransitions same-level End+Begin of the new think -> THINK_DISGUISE_NONE has NULL Begin/ThinkState (zero-init GlobalFuncs; InitDisguiseNone only sets IsState) -> per-frame dispatch skips NULL -> actor permanently inert in disguise state; no external scan ever runs because the scan lives inside idle-family thinks. Any OTHER disguise think swap mid-state is also End+Begin but lands in a working Begin (asserts m_Enemy; NULL enemy -> IDLE bail).

One-way blindness latch: 'attackplayer' -> ForceAttackPlayer -> ConfirmEnemy(entity 0) + m_bForceAttackPlayer=true, never cleared except actor respawn/ctor -> EnemyIsDisguised()==false forever for that actor -> attack transition passes against a disguised player -> that actor also suppresses the PLAYER's flag whenever its threat>0 (maintenance veto), radiating the blow-out to every other actor via the shared player flag.
constraints_for_designers: NEVER call attackplayer (or anything that reaches ForceAttackPlayer) on an actor while any player is or may become disguised: the latch is per-actor, permanent (cleared only at actor construction), auto-targets entity 0, and via the maintenance veto (once that actor attacks with threat>0) it un-disguises the player globally. Use HZM attackentity for targeted aggro; it confirms the enemy but does NOT set the latch - though confirming a currently-disguised player is still hostile intent the disguise system will fight.

NEVER change type_disguise (especially to 'none') while the actor could be inside THINKSTATE_DISGUISE - it hard-freezes the actor forever (bug-1631). Retire a checker only after verifying its thinkstate left DISGUISE (wait for idle/attack, or force SetThinkState via enableEnemy 0 first, which cleanly kicks DISGUISE->IDLE and clears the enemy - actor.cpp:8608-8627). 'type_disguise none' set while idle is safe and makes the actor never challenge (it will NOT attack a disguised player either - it just ignores the disguise interaction entirely).

The disguise-transition sight trace targets G_GetEntity(0)->centroid unconditionally (actor.cpp:9039-9051), and misc AI-noise suppression checks entity 0's disguise only (g_utils.cpp:1798-1804). In coop: challenges against non-host disguised players only initiate when PLAYER 0's centroid is traceable from the checker's eye; if player 0 is dead/spectating/elsewhere, sentries will not start papers checks on anyone else even though per-target EnemyIsDisguised works. Any m2l2a design must either keep the host in the stealth space or accept host-relative challenge behavior (or the engine must be patched to trace m_Enemy instead - flag as a deliberate engine change, exe/game.dll pairing rules apply).

m_bIsDisguised is recomputed EVERY frame from the active WEAPON_MAIN: any script that force-draws a weapon (loadout volleys, respawn re-arm, useweaponclass) blows the disguise instantly; InventoryItem-class items (papers, binoculars) are safe in hand. Respawn/loadout code running during a stealth window must leave the player holstered or holding an InventoryItem.

level.alarm and level.papers are exclusively script-owned; the engine never raises or lowers either. Alarm semantics are binary and level-wide: alarm=1 disables ALL disguise everywhere (not per-zone). If a design needs zone-local alerting, it cannot use level.alarm - it must gate per-actor (attackentity/enableEnemy) and accept that the engine disguise thinks still honor the global flag only.

Officer/rover-type checkers have NO accept path (State_Disguise_Fake_Papers): showing papers -> ENEMY, waiting 12 s -> ENEMY, walking >256u away -> HALT -> 1.5 s -> ATTACK. The only winning move is never letting the check start: stay outside disguise_range (default 256u), keep >48u vertical separation, break the entity-0 sight trace, or keep the encounter under the actor's cooldown. Do NOT place officer-type checkers on mandatory player paths unless the design intends a forced blow-out with a ~12 s fuse (halt gives 1.5s, ENEMY gives 3s grace before ATTACK).

Sentry-type checkers accept papers ONCE then self-demote to salute-type permanently (State_Disguise_Accept does SetThink(DISGUISE, THINK_DISGUISE_SALUTE)); they never re-check. A denied sentry (papers level too low) returns to IDLE - denial is NOT hostility - and re-challenges after ~disguise_period (default 30 s; scriptable per-actor in seconds via disguise_period). Design papers-gates around: first pass with papers >= disguise_level consumes the check.

Papers timing: the checker compares m_ShowPapersTime against a snapshot taken when its disguise think BEGAN - papers waved before the challenge started do not count; the player must fire the papers item during the PAPERS state (the item stamps at anim frames 30/40/50/60/70, so a single fire gives ~5 chances). Officer/rover treat a papers-show as the trigger to go hostile - players must be taught NOT to show papers to officers.

Disguise-state entry preconditions to honor in encounter layout: enemy CONFIRMED (visibility fully integrated - a player sprinting past a guard's FOV may never confirm), same floor (|dz|<=48u kills stairwell/catwalk checks), 32u < 2D distance < disguise_range, 200 ms scan cadence, per-actor cooldown (500 ms if the previous encounter only reached WAIT, 30 s otherwise). A guard glued <32u to the player will never initiate a check - point-blank stealth walk-bys are check-free by engine design.

FL_NOTARGET (notarget) short-circuits every hostile exit in the disguise thinks (treated like still-disguised) and PassesTransitionConditions_Attack - safe for cinematics, but note Begin still runs the papers snapshot and anims: a notarget player standing in range still triggers challenge THEATER, just never the attack exits.

Teammate (axis) gunfire clears each hearing actor's m_bEnemyIsDisguised belief (NoticeShot) and confirming events (ConfirmEnemy/ConfirmEnemyIfCanSeeSharerOrEnemy) do the same - but the player's LIVE flag ORs back in, so belief-clearing only matters while the player's flag is momentarily false (weapon drawn) or the player is unseen. Do not rely on 'one shot fired = everyone permanently alerted' without also raising level.alarm or latching aggro; conversely, do not assume belief-clears are harmless - they bite exactly when the player toggles a weapon.

The mod's script aggro pipeline must keep deferring to the engine flag (established bug-1639 direction): scripts must never latch (attackplayer) a currently-disguised player, and any scripted ConfirmEnemy path against a disguised player will be threat-starved (threat 0) and retention-held - producing the exact zero-threat limbo actors the bug-1631 veto fix exists to tolerate. Prefer letting the engine thinks drive stealth reactions; script only raises level.alarm / level.papers / has_disguise and places alarmnode/alarmthread wiring.

g_coopDisgParity 0 is the live kill-switch reverting to vanilla coop behavior (flag freezes at last computed value); g_coopDisgDebug 1 gates all HZM disguise tracers (state Begin/End/Suspend/Resume + ~2 Hz ticks + SETTHINK with script call trace + SETSTATE + player-entry evictions) - ^~^~^-prefixed, machine-parseable, and MUST stay default-off for players (dev_visibility rules).

Do not force players onto the axis team (team 0) while parity is on: the maintenance veto scan casts every team-0 sentient to Actor* unchecked; a Player on that list would be read through the wrong vtable layout (undefined behavior).

disguise_level accepts only 1 or 2 (else ScriptError + reset to 1); disguise_period is scripted in SECONDS (engine stores ms); disguise_range is scripted as a distance (engine stores its square). All three are per-actor and can be tuned live.
open_questions: THINK_BALCONY_DISGUISE (actor.h:380) - the balcony-guy variant was not audited; if m2l2a (or any stealth map) uses balcony actors near stealth spaces, its states/transitions need the same freeze-safety review before any type_disguise swaps target them.

PassesTransitionConditions_Disguise's hard-coded G_GetEntity(0) trace: acceptable for a host-present listen-server design, but a decision is needed whether to patch it (and G_BroadcastAIEvent's entity-0 check) to use m_Enemy for true per-player coop stealth - that is an engine behavior change with exe/game.dll shipping implications and should be a recorded decision either way.

Officer/sentry/rover thinks end with a doubled CheckForTransition(THINKSTATE_GRENADE) call ('if (!CheckForTransition(GRENADE)) CheckForTransition(GRENADE)') - vanilla quirk, harmless (second call re-tests after the first's failure), but worth knowing it is NOT a hook point: grenade thinkstate can interrupt a papers exchange at any tick, Suspend/Resume then re-runs Begin with a FRESH papers snapshot.

Salute think lacks the RequireThink() gate the other disguise thinks have - meaning saluters keep processing while unspawned-from-view edge cases would idle others; not observed as a problem, flagged for completeness.
